features.title: Automated Capacity Scheduling
features.description: Scheduling engine enforcing production lead times, blackout dates, checkout-hold expirations, and daily capacity limits to prevent overbooking.

features.title: Idempotent Payment Engine
features.description: PayPal Orders v2 integration with server-side capture verification and UUID idempotency keys to eliminate race conditions and duplicate transactions.

features.title: Secured Kitchen Operations Portal
features.description: Role-secured portal with OAuth2/JWT supporting date-based order filtering, real-time inventory toggling, and multi-stage fulfillment tracking.
